events.title: National Geographic Live - Wild Cats Revealed
events.description: Lions and tigers around the world are easily recognizable and thoroughly documented, but filmmaker and National Geographic Explorer Sandesh Kadur is on a mission to highlight his home country?s lesser-known felines to help protect their future. An unmatched diversity of wild cats live in India, from the towering Himalaya mountains to arid plains to dense jungles. Discover the tiny, grumpy-faced Pallas?s cat, the fishing cat that jumps into water to catch its prey, and the elusive clouded leopard. BAFTA Award-winning filmmaker Sandesh Kadur is a National Geographic Society Fellow. He creates documentaries that have aired worldwide on prominent networks such as National Geographic, the BBC, Netflix, Discovery Channel, and Animal Planet.

events.title: Rhythm & Roots: Soul Amplified
events.description: Experience an evening where R&B, soul, culture, legacy, and philanthropy come together. Rhythm & Roots returns for its second year with Soul Amplified, celebrating the impact and future of Black philanthropy through music and storytelling. Back by popular demand, Al Jasper & Friends return to the stage, followed by Gena Does Tina, a high-energy Tina Turner tribute led by powerhouse Carolina vocalist Gena Chambers. Celebrate Charlotte's Black philanthropic legacy as we honor the changemakers shaping the community. Proceeds support the Foundation For Black Philanthropy's grantmaking, programs, and continued investment in organizations serving Charlotte's Black community. VIP Ticket Upgrade: Elevate your Rhythm & Roots evening with early access to the exclusive Prelude Reception beginning at 5:30 p.m., featuring hors d'oeuvres, beer and wine, the Artist Corner live music experience, complimentary valet parking, and premium concert seating.
